summary: Sabine County, Texas site listed as Yellowpine (Loc 2) and marked gone; tnlandforms has one Yellowpine entry at nearly the same spot. No build or fate records found.

facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the Loc 2 tower as gone; no source describes the site now.

notes_for_editor: Brief checked: FFLA lists Loc 2 as Tower Gone at 31.28204, -93.81119; no correction needed. tnlandforms has one Yellowpine entry at 31.28204, -93.81191; its latitude matches Loc 2 and its longitude differs by about 0.0007 degrees (roughly 70 m). Which longitude is right is not known from the sources. The sources do not say whether Loc 1 and Loc 2 stood at the same time, so the story does not say. No build, height, design, staffing, fire or fate record in the sources read or in two searches. Same leads as Loc 1: Find a Grave Yellowpine Cemetery page (403, not used; snippet gives 'Fire Tower Cemetery' as an alternate name) and an anyplaceamerica 'Yellowpine Lookout' snippet (USGS ID 1383006, not read). Confidence low.
